meta.subject: fix: a bug about operand in vALUv2, and num_warp issue

en.summary: Fixes a vector-ALU operand-selection bug by taking the reverse flag and swapped operands from the registered execute-stage inputs instead of the live upstream bus.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly mentions an operand bug in `vALUv2`.
`execution.scala` changes core execute-stage vector ALU datapath logic.
The fix brings the reverse-operand path into the same pipeline stage as the rest of the ALU inputs, preventing mixed-cycle operands.
disqualifiers: The commit also changes `num_warp` and updates tests, so it is a mixed commit.
The parameter and test edits are not required to describe or inject the DUT bug.
evidence: Before the fix, the reverse path used `io.in.bits.ctrl.reverse`, `io.in.bits.in2(x)`, and `io.in.bits.in1(x)` even though the main ALU inputs already used `inReg`.
The patch changes all three references to `inReg`, aligning control and operands to the registered execute stage.
The other touched files are `parameters.scala` and tests, which do not alter the localized operand-selection bug.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: In a pipelined ALU, operand-swizzle controls such as reverse/subtract-source swapping must come from the same buffered stage as the operands themselves. If only the special reverse path peeks at the live upstream bus while the rest of the datapath uses registered inputs, stalls or overlapping requests can mix control and operands from different cycles. The operation remains syntactically valid but computes on the wrong source pair.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Reverse-enabled ALU operations under pipeline delay, backpressure, or any situation where the upstream bus may change while the execute stage still holds an older instruction.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Make the reverse-operand mux read control and swapped operands from the live input bus instead of the execute-stage register.
portability_notes: Apply this where a special-case operand swap or reverse mode exists alongside a registered execute stage.
The fault is most visible when the execute stage can stall or when upstream inputs can change independently of the held instruction.
Only the reverse/swap path should bypass the register; leaving the normal path registered recreates the real mixed-stage bug.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the execute-stage ALU input selection logic and identify the reverse or operand-swap condition.
Keep the normal operands sourced from the stage register, but change the reverse-case control and swapped operand selection to read from the live input interface.
Do not alter unrelated functional-unit timing or configuration parameters; the bug is specifically a stage-consistency violation.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: `vALUv2` reverse-operand selection in the execute stage
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix replaces `io.in.bits.ctrl.reverse`, `io.in.bits.in2(x)`, and `io.in.bits.in1(x)` with their registered `inReg` counterparts inside the reverse path of `vALUv2`.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In the `vALUv2` block, change the reverse-case condition and swapped operands back from `inReg.*` to `io.in.bits.*` while leaving the surrounding normal-path inputs unchanged.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Reverse-enabled vector ALU instructions can consume stale or mismatched operands, producing incorrect arithmetic or logic results when the pipeline is stalled or overlapped.
evidence_for_injection: The normal ALU inputs already came from `inReg`; only the reverse path was inconsistent before the fix.
The patch changes exactly three references in the reverse block, making the source of the bug highly localized.
The mixed `num_warp` change is separate and does not weaken the execute-stage operand-selection evidence.
notes: For reinjection, ignore the `num_warp` and test edits; they are unrelated to the portable bug mechanism.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了向量 ALU 的操作数选择缺陷：反向操作时改为从执行级寄存输入而不是实时上游总线获取 reverse 控制和交换后的操作数。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确提到了 `vALUv2` 的操作数 bug。
`execution.scala` 修改的是执行级核心向量 ALU 数据通路逻辑。
该修复让 reverse 操作路径与 ALU 其余输入处于同一个流水级，避免混用不同周期的操作数。
disqualifiers: 该提交还修改了 `num_warp` 并更新了测试，因此它是一个混合提交。
这些参数和测试改动并不是描述或注入该 DUT 缺陷所必需的。
evidence: 修复前，reverse 路径使用 `io.in.bits.ctrl.reverse`、`io.in.bits.in2(x)` 和 `io.in.bits.in1(x)`，而主 ALU 输入已经使用 `inReg`。
补丁把这三处引用全部改成 `inReg`，使控制和操作数都与寄存后的执行级保持一致。
其余修改文件是 `parameters.scala` 和测试，不影响这个局部的操作数选择缺陷。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 在流水线 ALU 中，reverse 或交换操作数这类特殊控制必须与操作数本身来自同一个缓冲流水级。如果只有 reverse 路径偷看实时上游总线，而其余数据通路都使用寄存后的输入，那么在阻塞或多请求重叠时，就会把不同周期的控制和操作数混在一起。该操作在语法上仍然合法，但会对错误的源操作数对进行计算。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 操作数反转路径的流水级一致性
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 带 reverse 的 ALU 指令遇到流水线延迟、回压，或任何会导致执行级仍保持旧指令而上游总线已经变化的情况。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让 reverse 操作数 mux 从实时输入总线而不是执行级寄存器读取控制和交换后的操作数。
portability_notes: 应在存在寄存执行级、且同时支持特殊交换或 reverse 操作数模式的位置实施该故障。
当执行级可能停顿，或者上游输入可以独立于当前保持指令而变化时，该故障最明显。
只让 reverse/交换路径绕过寄存器；普通路径仍保持寄存，才能最贴近原始的混级 bug。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位执行级 ALU 的输入选择逻辑，并找到 reverse 或操作数交换条件。
保持普通操作数仍来自该级寄存器，但把 reverse 情况下的控制和交换后操作数改为读取实时输入接口。
不要改动无关功能单元时序或配置参数；该缺陷本质上是流水级一致性被破坏。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: 执行级中 `vALUv2` 的反向操作数选择逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复在 `vALUv2` 的 reverse 路径中，把 `io.in.bits.ctrl.reverse`、`io.in.bits.in2(x)` 和 `io.in.bits.in1(x)` 替换成了对应的 `inReg` 信号。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 `vALUv2` 代码块中，把 reverse 分支里的条件和交换后操作数从 `inReg.*` 改回 `io.in.bits.*`，同时保持周围普通路径输入不变。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 开启 reverse 的向量 ALU 指令在流水线阻塞或重叠时可能读取陈旧或不匹配的操作数，导致算术或逻辑结果错误。
evidence_for_injection: 普通 ALU 输入原本就来自 `inReg`；修复前只有 reverse 路径与其不一致。
补丁只修改了 reverse 代码块中的三处引用，说明 bug 定位非常集中。
混入的 `num_warp` 变更与该执行级操作数选择证据无关。
notes: 重新注入时应忽略 `num_warp` 和测试改动，它们与可移植的 bug 机制无关。
